title: Tandoori Chicken
description: Tandoori Chicken is a classic North Indian dish featuring chicken marinated in ginger-garlic, Kashmiri chili, hung yogurt, mustard oil, and aromatic spices, then cooked at high heat for a smoky, charred exterior and juicy, flavorful interior.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Whole chicken – 1, about 1.2–1.5 kg, cut into 8–10 pieces

ingredients.title: First Marinade
items: Ginger-garlic paste – 2 tbsp, fresh and finely ground

ingredients.title: Second Marinade
items: Kashmiri red chili powder – 1 tbsp, adjust to taste
Cumin powder – 1 tsp, roasted and freshly ground
Coriander powder – 1 tsp, roasted and freshly ground
Kasuri methi – 1 tbsp, roasted and crushed

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Melted butter or ghee – 2 tbsp, for basting

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Chicken
steps: Make 2–3 deep slits in each chicken piece so the marinades can penetrate deeply.
Rub the chicken with salt and lemon juice.
Let it rest for 15 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 2 – First Marinade
steps: Coat the chicken thoroughly with ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri red chili powder, and salt.
Let the chicken rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Second Marinade
steps: Whisk the hung yogurt until smooth.
Add mustard oil, Kashmiri red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, garam masala, black salt, kasuri methi, chaat masala, and green chilies, if using.
Coat the chicken evenly with the marinade, massaging it deeply into the slits.
Cover and refrigerate for 6–8 hours. Overnight marination gives the best flavor.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Cooking in a Tandoor
steps: Preheat the tandoor until very hot.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, basting with melted butter or ghee.
Finish with a quick high-heat char for a smoky, slightly blackened exterior.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Oven Alternative
steps: Preheat the oven to 250°C (480°F).
Place the chicken on a rack positioned over a baking tray.
Roast for 18–20 minutes.
Switch to broil or grill mode for about 5 minutes to develop a charred exterior.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Grill or BBQ Alternative
steps: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Place the marinated chicken on the grill, cover, and cook for 15–18 minutes.
Turn the chicken periodically and baste with melted butter or ghee while cooking.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Finishing and Serving
steps: Brush the cooked chicken with melted butter or ghee just before serving.
Sprinkle with chaat masala.
Serve with onion rings, lemon wedges, fresh coriander, and mint chutney.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with onion rings, lemon wedges, and mint chutney.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and a light sprinkle of chaat masala.
Pair with naan, roti, or a fresh Indian salad for a complete meal.

chefTips: Heat mustard oil lightly until smoking, then cool it before adding it to the marinade to remove its raw smell and enhance its smoky flavor.
Use thick hung curd so the marinade clings properly to the chicken instead of dripping off.
Kashmiri red chili powder provides the signature vibrant red color without excessive heat.
Make deep slits in the chicken so the marinades penetrate beyond the surface.
For an extra smoky restaurant-style aroma without a tandoor, use the dhungar method with hot charcoal and a drop of ghee.
Longer marination, preferably overnight, produces more flavorful and tender chicken.
